responsibility: This file implements the common infrastructure shared by the main LTO front end and the lto-dump tool. It owns front-end initialization for streamed GIMPLE input, section-table and file-data helper structures, deserialization of declaration-state records, canonical type hashing/registration used while reading multiple IL files, EH-personality selection state, symbol/cgraph reading and merging support, and the LTO statistics/reporting path; in practice it is the core stream-in and shared-runtime layer that prepares trees, types, symtab state, and reader hooks before higher-level LTO, WPA, or dump-mode control flow runs.
same_name_distinction: This is the compiled implementation for the lto-common pair: it defines the shared stream-in/runtime machinery used by lto.c and lto-dump, including lto_fe_init, read-side state, and report/personality support, whereas gcc/lto/lto-common.h only declares those entry points and globals.
